column1: # Player batch: owner <TAB> M <TAB> old <TAB> descriptor <TAB> semantic name
# Getter letters do NOT match field letters here, so every entry was named from the field the
# body actually touches: a=int id, b=Controller, c=long ?, d=bool alive, e=Faction, f=Team,
# g=long money (buildUnit subtracts and cancel refunds cost), h=long ?, i=UnitTypeList,
# j=FogOfWar, k=UnitGroupSet, l=bool exploration, m=bool fog, n=int ?, o=PlayerStatistics.
# Evidence: World.runSetup scales player.g() and player.l() by AI difficulty; AnnihilationMode
# counts only players where d() is true (isAlive); SkirmishSetupScreen offers "Exploration +
# Fog / Exploration Only / Fog Only", and setupPlayers feeds fogOfWar.a(!m()) / .b(!n()),
# Six rows stay blank on purpose: the long c, the long h (100 at creation, difficulty-scaled,
# used as a per-structure strength weight) and the int n appear only in WorldSerializer, with
# no call site or label to establish their meaning.
